art_direction: Established lateral minimal dark-fantasy pixel art; approved sources and spec; no new lore, clothing exposure or covered/horse wagon.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one reusable side-view environment background for The First Nine, NOT a storyboard or collage. Style: simplified dark-fantasy pixel art, deliberate large pixel clusters, short palettes, silhouette first, minimal faces, no painted microtexture. Landscape 16:9, target 1920x1080. Keep key figures within safe margins and bottom 15 percent low-detail for later caption overlay. No text, letters, speech balloons, symbols of cursing, gutters, labels or watermark. All people fully clothed, opaque trousers and boots; no nudity or gore. One open wooden family wagon, no horse, no canopy or covered wagon whenever the wagon is present. References are style/identity guidance, not layouts to copy. Do not add unrequested characters or narrative events. Scene: Wide true interior of the root-lined Thornwake cave. Empty side-view playable refuge, rock walls and ceiling clearly overhead, flat continuous floor near the lower quarter, matching tall root-framed opening at one end. Reserve unobstructed floor space for one wagon, a fire and eight lying patients to be placed later. No people, wagon, fire, chests, UI or labels baked into the image; ambient cool cave lighting suitable for dynamic day/night.
